note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; only the soldier is described, the worker and the alate are not recorded; the OCR of the original drops the leading 0 from the measurements of pronotal width, hind tibia length and left mandible length (given as “.53-0.63”, “.61-0.73” and “.47-0.57”), treated here as 0.53–0.63, 0.61–0.73 and 0.47–0.57 respectively; the description is based on a few soldiers (stored in the same vial as Acanthotermes spiniger); synonymy, figure numbers and localities are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow; the sides only slightly rounded, nearly parallel; with very few setae. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 very small and equal in length, segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together. Labrum lingulate. Fontanelle indistinct. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly notched. Measurements (mm): head length 1.50–1.63, head width 0.77–0.87, pronotal length 0.36, width 0.53–0.63, hind tibia length 0.61–0.73, left mandible length 0.47–0.57.
